SELECT DISTINCT T2.TagName FROM posts AS T1 INNER JOIN users AS T3 ON T1.OwnerUserId = T3.Id INNER JOIN tags AS T2 ON instr(T1.Tags, '<' || T2.TagName || '>') > 0 WHERE T3.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes' AND T1.CommentCount = 0 AND T1.Tags IS NOT NULL AND T1.Tags <> '' ORDER BY T2.TagName

WITH RECURSIVE split(tag, rest) AS (
  SELECT substr(p.Tags, 2, instr(p.Tags, '>') - 2) AS tag,
         substr(p.Tags, instr(p.Tags, '>') + 1) AS rest
  FROM posts AS p
  INNER JOIN users AS u ON p.OwnerUserId = u.Id
  WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes'
    AND p.CommentCount = 0
    AND p.Tags IS NOT NULL
    AND p.Tags LIKE '<%>'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT substr(rest, 2, instr(rest, '>') - 2),
         substr(rest, instr(rest, '>') + 1)
  FROM split
  WHERE rest LIKE '<%>'
)
SELECT DISTINCT tag
FROM split
WHERE tag <> ''
ORDER BY tag

WITH RECURSIVE
base AS (
  SELECT p.Id AS post_id, trim(p.Tags, '<>') AS tagstr
  FROM posts p
  JOIN users u ON u.Id = p.OwnerUserId
  WHERE u.DisplayName = 'Mark Meckes'
    AND p.CommentCount = 0
    AND p.Tags IS NOT NULL
    AND p.Tags <> ''
),
post_tags(post_id, tag, rest) AS (
  SELECT
    post_id,
    CASE WHEN instr(tagstr, '><') = 0 THEN tagstr ELSE substr(tagstr, 1, instr(tagstr, '><') - 1) END,
    CASE WHEN instr(tagstr, '><') = 0 THEN '' ELSE substr(tagstr, instr(tagstr, '><') + 2) END
  FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT
    post_id,
    CASE WHEN instr(rest, '><') = 0 THEN rest ELSE substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, '><') - 1) END,
    CASE WHEN instr(rest, '><') = 0 THEN '' ELSE substr(rest, instr(rest, '><') + 2) END
  FROM post_tags
  WHERE rest <> ''
)
SELECT DISTINCT tag
FROM post_tags
WHERE tag <> ''
ORDER BY tag;
